notes: REVERSED PARTY BLOCKS. Section I is PODACI O RADNIKU (employee) and section II is PODACI O POSLODAVCU (employer) — the opposite order to B01 and C01. An extractor keying on block position rather than the heading will swap the two OIBs on this sample.
Two-page document, but everything except sections XII–XIV is on page 1.
ukupnoSati is 200 (hours actually paid, section VI row 2), not 176 (REDOVNI MJESEČNI FOND SATI, row 1). Leaf pay components sum to exactly 200 hours and 1220.00.
koeficijent holds the printed satnica (6.25 EUR/h) rather than a multiplier — this layout uses the same column for an hourly rate.
MIO I. stup is charged on a reduced base of 1180.00 (a -40.00 'umanjenje osnovice') while MIO II. stup uses 1220.00. Verified: 1180 x 15% = 177.00, 1220 x 5% = 61.00.
doprinosiNaPlacu of 201.31 equals 1220.00 x 16.5%, although section XIII.1 prints the osnovica as 1180.00. The document is internally inconsistent here; the printed amount is recorded.
